body.message:
Good afternoon Tamara,

I hope you’re doing well.

We have your client’s booking starting from 1st September, and we received your request to proceed with the payment. Please find our bank details below for your reference.

Once the payment has been completed, kindly share the payment receipt with us so we can update the booking accordingly.

Please note that if you choose to pay the rent via the payment link, a 3.1% card processing fee will be added. Payments made by bank transfer will not incur any additional charges.

Thank you, and please let us know if you need any assistance.
